name: episode_id
description: Denormalized from the checkpoint at decision time so per-episode queries need no join (NULL on rows written before the column existed; the checkpoint join is authoritative)

name: exported_at
description: Snapshot upload time (microsecond precision); the *_latest views key on it

name: export_phase
description: ladder_complete (final verdict recorded) | outcome_final (re-export after ground-truth labeling)

name: export_session
description: Harness session that ran the export
